top_signals.title: Treasury sanctions operation targets Iran's auto, rail industries in latest economic attack
top_signals.summary: "Operation Economic Outcast" was touted by President Donald Trump as Iran's "economic D-Day" when Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent unveiled it in August.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: U.S. trade representative Greer says deal with India not 'imminent' after Modi-Trump call
top_signals.summary: Ties between the U.S. and India have been under strain for over a year, and New Delhi faces fresh risk of up to 100% tariffs for continuing to buy Russian oil.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
